title: THE FASHION OPERATOR PANEL KEEPS ITS FRAME
why: Found by the review of 2026-10-07: since v18.81 the Your operator panel in FASHION scrolled as a whole, so its thin inner frame line scrolled with it, the top edge vanished and the bottom edge rose up through the slot rows. An inner box now scrolls instead, the way the racks do, so the frame and the heading stay put.
now: Scrolling the FASHION slot list keeps the panel frame and heading still.
